runs.t: High-performing, prefabricated laboratory facilities. Utilizing components similar to the NetZERO Building Platform, Clark Pacific delivers complete structural lab systems for life sciences, R&D, and advanced technology.

Our structural lab solution offers the most economical solution for achieving premium-level vibration performance compared to all competing structural systems. Floor framing is designed for structural efficiency and superior strength and stiffness — allowing total grid spacing freedom and RMS velocities as low as 2,000 mips with significantly fewer columns.
Achieve spans up to 48' on a 33' column grid — simplifying current and future tenant improvements for the most demanding life sciences and R&D programs.

Manufactured offsite, the lab structural components — floor, beams, columns, walls — are extremely durable while reducing building weight and embodied carbon.

Clark Pacific Lab Solutions deliver important cost savings and superior performance and flexibility across a range of life sciences, R&D, and advanced technology programs — leveraging decades of structural design expertise.
CARBONSHIELD® is a unique and proprietary concrete mix developed by Clark Pacific that provides the same performance as traditional mixes and is standard in our structural products.
It replaces 25% of the portland cement in our concrete mixes, reducing embodied carbon by roughly 20%. Our goal is double this by 2030, through our continuous R&D efforts and material partnerships.
